games.section: games / group 1: حروف الألف والباء / lesson 1

observed_reference.flow: tap to start → title card → big letter + pointing hand → tap → 5 plants grow → letter shows on one plant at a time (framed) → tap it → plant smiles → after 5: middle plants leave, picture walks in small with pointing hand → tap → picture grows, word appears → tap word → first letter separates in colour → next letter → curtain → back to list with tick
observed_reference.layouts: alef: 5 square-crown trees, alternating heights; ba: 5 round shrubs, 3 back + 2 front
observed_reference.scoring: no stars or score screen for this lesson; completion tick only (URL carries duration and mistakes)

comparison_score.basis: Played to the end on both reference and Silah; side-by-side shots in project files (silah-games/G-001/compare.png). Self-assessed, not yet approved by Alaa.

remaining_issues: Voice is the browser's Arabic text-to-speech, not recorded audio; the reference uses recorded voice.
Motion timings estimated from screenshots, not frame-measured.
Shrub highlight frame is an oval, the reference uses a rounded square.
Duck picture is a single sprite with its pond; the reference pond is wider than the duck.
Touch tested only in emulation (Playwright hasTouch), not on a real phone or iPad.
